obligations.title: Authority fingerprint
obligations.requirement: Every implementation/qualification claim is tied to the exact active authority fingerprint and tested source SHA; documentation or code drift invalidates affected closure.

obligations.title: Inherited ownership
obligations.requirement: ELV5 must reuse ELV3/ELV4 canonical ownership for revisions, cables, ports, components, power sources, battery banks, physical kernels and command/history infrastructure.
obligations.acceptance: P0 ownership audit and P9 duplicate-owner reconciliation.

obligations.title: Strong domain identities
obligations.requirement: Domain/scope/subject/process/evidence identities are closed typed values; semantic identity must not collapse to unvalidated free strings.

obligations.title: Explicit field resolution
obligations.requirement: Known, Missing, NotApplicable, Unsupported and Unresolved are explicit semantic states; null must not encode engineering meaning.

obligations.title: Dimension-safe exact quantities
obligations.requirement: Engineering quantities use code-owned legal algebra and exact/bounded arithmetic; dB and dBm, bit/s and byte capacity, power and energy remain distinct types.

obligations.title: Evidence and uncertainty
obligations.requirement: Every requirement-affecting value carries source/evidence/applicability and measurement uncertainty where applicable; typical/estimated evidence cannot satisfy guaranteed-bound claims.

obligations.title: Deterministic time
obligations.requirement: Recurring schedules use captured timezone-rule evidence, explicit DST behavior and half-open intervals; host timezone/tzdb defaults cannot change deterministic results.

obligations.title: Coordinate-frame provenance
obligations.requirement: Geometry uses explicit frame/transform identity; coordinates in different frames cannot be mixed without a captured transform chain.

obligations.title: Deterministic requirement composition
obligations.requirement: Requirement merging, reserve/derating composition and conflict resolution are code-owned and deterministic; no intuitive or UI-selected winner is allowed.

obligations.title: Unified result algebra
obligations.requirement: All 27 processes use common applicability, comparison, positive-headroom margin, governing-case, limiting-factor, dimension-status and deterministic trace semantics.

obligations.title: Schema 24 additive persistence
obligations.requirement: ELV5 persistence is additive schema 24 with explicit PK/FK/index/active-uniqueness rules and no duplicate physical ownership.
obligations.acceptance: P2/P8 migration, restart and owner-isolation tests.

obligations.title: Exact 16-command wire surface
obligations.requirement: The public discipline command family remains exactly 16 operations with strict schema/payload validation, replay-first behavior and canonical request hashing.
obligations.acceptance: P2/P8 codec, replay and conflict matrix.

obligations.title: Atomic mutation UoW
obligations.requirement: Root/member replacement, old+new invalidation, history and ledger persistence commit atomically and roll back together on failure.

obligations.title: Capture-run-publish separation
obligations.requirement: Calculations use short coherent capture, pure calculation outside DB write transaction and short guarded all-or-nothing publication.

obligations.title: Immutable evaluations and pointers
obligations.requirement: Technical evaluations are immutable; CURRENT/STALE pointer freshness is separate from execution/completion/assessment and guarded by generation/fingerprint revalidation.
obligations.acceptance: P2/P7/P8 replay, stale and freeze tests.

obligations.title: 27x25 process dossiers
obligations.requirement: Every one of 27 processes implements exactly the 25 mandatory dossier sections; package summaries may not override equations, boundaries, worst-case, governing, limiting, complexity or vector semantics.
obligations.acceptance: CI dossier guard plus P3-P6 process qualification.

obligations.title: CCTV flow accounting
obligations.requirement: CCTV-02 counts explicit directed stream copies; unicast duplicates by receiver/path, multicast deduplicates only under declared tree/group evidence, and payload bitrate remains separate from physical wire rate.

obligations.title: CCTV storage integration
obligations.requirement: CCTV-03 unions half-open recorded intervals, integrates exact bits/8, applies reserve once, performs process-boundary ceil once and separates expected estimate from guaranteed retention.

obligations.title: LAN installed path and compatibility
obligations.requirement: LAN path calculations use realized ordered sections exactly once, preserve physical resource identity and let the weakest incompatible path element govern compatibility.

obligations.title: Bidirectional optical budget
obligations.requirement: LAN-05 independently proves sensitivity and overload in both directions using dB loss intervals and dBm optical levels; power budget never implies reach/dispersion without a separate model.

obligations.title: ACS transient electrical model
obligations.requirement: ACS-03 distinguishes control path from conductive feed, branch from shared-trunk current and steady from startup/inrush cases; bounded event policy chooses the governing transient.
obligations.acceptance: ACS-03 five-vector suite and corrected oracle.

obligations.title: ACS shared source, autonomy and release
obligations.requirement: ACS-04/05 reuse complete ELV4 source/bank evidence; ACS-06 evaluates canonical five-cause release truth tables for fail-safe/fail-secure/project-defined behavior without claiming legal compliance.

obligations.title: Fire current/source/autonomy
obligations.requirement: FA-02/04/05 use complete uniquely identified current origins, shared-source requirement composition and explicit ordered standby/alarm sequences with no hidden default durations.

obligations.title: Fire circuit/topology/policy limits
obligations.requirement: FA address, electrical, notification, signal-topology and policy dimensions remain separate; unsupported electrical/fault models and technical policy matches cannot become false compliance PASS.

obligations.title: Typed dependency graph
obligations.requirement: Dependencies include FACT/SET/POLICY/EVAL/POINTER/MISSING plus selector-aware membership markers, with deterministic canonical identity.
obligations.acceptance: P7 dependency key and restart tests.

obligations.title: Old+new selector invalidation
obligations.requirement: Every mutation invalidates union(oldClosure,newClosure), including insertion of newly matching selector members and creation of previously missing evidence.

obligations.title: Incremental recomputation
obligations.requirement: Production recalculation operates on the exact affected transitive closure; a generic recalculate-all fallback is not acceptable for normal mutations.

obligations.title: Atomic coherent batch publish
obligations.requirement: A requested coherent calculation batch either advances all validated target pointers or none; worker failure/cancellation/conflict must never partially publish the batch.

obligations.title: Stable public inventories
obligations.requirement: Runtime must reconcile exactly 80 stable package requirements, 27 process codes, 27 algorithm mappings, 16 public commands and schema 24 at the accepted source SHA.

obligations.title: Downstream claim boundaries
obligations.requirement: ELV5 must not claim ELV6 cabinet/layout fit, ELV7 jurisdictional compliance/certification or ELV8 commercial SKU/BOM/procurement outcomes.
obligations.acceptance: Cross-discipline vectors and P9 handoff audit.

obligations.title: Reference oracle arithmetic integrity
obligations.requirement: Canonical reference vectors are executable arithmetic oracles; the ACS-03 fixture uses Vterminal=23.51 V and +1.51 V low-voltage headroom for the published inputs, and contradictory golden values are invalid.
obligations.acceptance: CI oracle guard and ACS-03 executable fixture.

obligations.title: Native worker execution
obligations.requirement: Medium/large native engineering workloads execute through Elv5CalculationExecutor outside the Flutter UI isolate using bounded long-lived worker isolate(s)/pool.

obligations.title: Deterministic parallelism and cache
obligations.requirement: Worker count/completion order cannot change canonical output; semantic cache keys include process/algorithm/schema/numeric/authority/input fingerprints.
obligations.acceptance: workerCount=1 vs N and cache hit/miss proofs.

obligations.title: Cancellation, supersession and backpressure
obligations.requirement: Rapid edits cancel/supersede/coalesce obsolete jobs; stale completion may not advance CURRENT or create an unbounded queue.

obligations.title: 135 process-vector qualification
obligations.requirement: Qualification includes at least 27 positive, 27 negative/unsupported, 27 boundary, 27 adversarial and 27 cross-discipline process vectors while retaining exactly 54 primary public vertical entries.
obligations.acceptance: P8 qualification manifest and dossier vector mapping.

obligations.title: No-false-PASS sentinels
obligations.requirement: Unsupported/missing/uncertain/typical/stale/what-if/downstream-scope states cannot be promoted to authoritative technical PASS beyond their exact claim scope.

obligations.title: Scale and resource bounds
obligations.requirement: All kernels obey dossier complexity/resource bounds on scale fixtures; pathological quadratic behavior, unbounded exact arithmetic and unbounded diagnostics are closure-blocking.

obligations.title: Bulk indexed persistence
obligations.requirement: Capture/publish uses bounded bulk repository access and required indexes; N+1 query behavior on supported scale fixtures is prohibited.

obligations.title: Flutter targeted UI projection
obligations.requirement: Engineering math/SQLite must not run in build(); large collections are lazy/virtualized and one result change rebuilds only affected immutable projections.

obligations.title: Profile-mode performance evidence
obligations.requirement: Performance acceptance is measured in Flutter profile mode with source SHA, authority fingerprint, platform/runtime versions, frame metrics, phase timings, memory/cardinalities and worker/cache metrics.

obligations.title: Review-result separation
obligations.requirement: Engineer acknowledgement, waiver or workflow review is separate from immutable technical evaluation and cannot rewrite FAIL, outputHash or governing result.

obligations.title: Closure event separation
obligations.requirement: Design hardening, runtime implementation, functional qualification, performance qualification, merge and CLOSED are separate evidenced events.
